document_metadata.doc_title: 253、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.title: 253、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.summary: Caroline learns Benjamin was her father, confronts Daisy for never revealing the truth, and leaves upset; Daisy reflects on their shared loss.
document_metadata.source_title: 253、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: Caroline's stopped reading... dead still... CAROLINE He was my father...? This Benjamin was my father? (MORE) . CONTINUED: CAROLINE (CONT'D) Why didn't you ever tell me...?! DAISY It doesn't change for a moment who you are. You were a gift. Sometimes the gifts we are given are not free. CAROLINE You never said a word to me... Caroline, upset, gets up... CAROLINE (CONT'D) I need to go for a minute... She leaves the room... DAISY (enigmatic) My dearest darling, we were both deprived of him... Daisy lying still... in her turban... her blue eyes... her breathing rasping...

document_metadata.title: 256、INT. THEIR BEDROOM, SUBURBAN TOWNHOUSE, NEW ORLEANS -
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin, a 34-year-old man appearing young for his 51 years, lies awake at night beside his sleeping baby and partner Daisy, who shows signs of aging; their mutual unease surfaces as she senses his distress.
document_metadata.source_title: 256、INT. THEIR BEDROOM, SUBURBAN TOWNHOUSE, NEW ORLEANS -

chunks.content: NIGHT, The room's dark. We see Benjamin in bed, the baby sleeping between him and Daisy... And as Benjamin watches them sleep... he looks at his reflection in a wall mirror... his 51st year on this earth... 34 years old... a young man... He looks at his baby... he looks at Daisy... in her mid 40s... her hair's begun to gray... her face begun to show the natural touches of age... His stare awakens her... She looks at him sensing he's deeply troubled... He shuts his eyes... she watches him sleep, Daisy as troubled as he is... but for very different reasons...

document_metadata.title: 257、EXT. A PARK - NEW ORLEANS - DAY,
document_metadata.summary: Daisy fears Benjamin is leaving her as she questions her aging and his feelings, while Benjamin remains silent, reflecting on a past birthday celebration.
document_metadata.source_title: 257、EXT. A PARK - NEW ORLEANS - DAY,

chunks.content: Benjamin is sitting with Caroline while she plays in a park's sand box... Caroline helping herself to a mouthful of sand... Benjamin, trying to get the sand out of her mouth... BENJAMIN Don't eat sand... Daisy comes over to sit with them... BENJAMIN (CONT'D) She's going to have a really attractive diaper. As they sit watching Caroline playing in the sand... CONTINUED: BENJAMIN (CONT'D) I think you should find a real father for her... DAISY What are you talking about? BENJAMIN She needs someone to grow old with... DAISY She'll learn to accept whatever happens... She loves you... BENJAMIN She needs a father not a playmate.

metadata.source_title: 257、EXT. A PARK - NEW ORLEANS - DAY,

chunks.content: DAISY Is it that my age is starting to show...? Is that what you are telling me? Have you lost your desire for me...? BENJAMIN You don't need another child to raise... DAISY You're going to leave me, aren't you? He doesn't say anything. DAISY (CONT'D) You can't leave me. He's silent. DAISY (CONT'D) You can't do this to me...!BENJAMIN BUTTON'S (V.O.) It was your first birthday. We had a party... the house was filled with people... .

document_metadata.title: 261、INT. THEIR BEDROOM - SUBURBAN TOWNHOUSE - LATE AT NIGHT,
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin leaves silently, ensuring Daisy and her mother can have a life, after selling his assets and leaving behind a bank book and key.
document_metadata.source_title: 261、INT. THEIR BEDROOM - SUBURBAN TOWNHOUSE - LATE AT NIGHT,

chunks.content: Benjamin, dressed, watching Caroline in her crib, asleep. Daisy in bed, asleep. BENJAMIN BUTTON'S (V.O.) I sold the summer house on Lake Pontchartrain... I sold my share of Button's Buttons... I sold the sailboat... I put it all into an account for your mother... And before you would ever remember me... And he bends to kiss his sleeping daughter, whispering to her... BENJAMIN I want you to know I love you... He stops to put a bank book on the dresser, along with a house key... the sound of the key is just enough for Daisy to stir. He starts to leave... He turns to go... and he sees Daisy is looking at him... A look not so much of anger, or hurt, not of resignation, but a look of acceptance... that this is what her life is now...

document_metadata.doc_title: 264、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.title: 264、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.summary: Caroline reads Benjamin's message from postcards, reflecting on his global journey and his belief that it's never too late to change and live the life one wants.
document_metadata.source_title: 264、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: Daisy, in her regal turban, silently looking out the window... the wind knocking loudly again... CAROLINE I almost wish I didn't know any of this. (she's quiet, after a beat) I feel odd, reading...it... She looks at the book... . CONTINUED: CAROLINE (CONT'D) Where did he go? DAISY I don't know. I never heard from him. Caroline, distant, picks through the book...She comes upon... CAROLINE There are postcards... Looking through them... CAROLINE (CONT'D) They're all addressed to me... They're from all sorts of places... And she realizes... CAROLINE (CONT'D) They're for my birthday. (reading) ...I would have been two... "Happy Birthday." "I wish I could have kissed you goodnight." (reading, another one) "Happy Birthday, you're five." "I wish I could have taken you to your first day of school." (reading on) "Happy Birthday six-year-old." "I wish I could be there to teach you how to play the piano..." (reading on) "11..." "...Told you not to chase some boy..." "13..." "Held you when you had a broken heart..." "1983." I was fifteen. "I wish I could have been your father. Nothing I ever did will replace that..."

metadata.doc_title: 264、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
metadata.title: 264、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
metadata.summary: Caroline reads Benjamin's message from postcards, reflecting on his global journey and his belief that it's never too late to change and live the life one wants.
metadata.source_title: 264、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: Daisy murmurs... Which brings Caroline back to the book... CAROLINE (CONT'D) (reads) What I think is...\" -162. AROUND THE WORLD And Benjamin's voice comes in... WHILE WE SEE HIM IN VARIOUS PLACES ALL OVER THE WORLD, A MONTAGE, A FILM WITHIN A FILM, OF THE ROAD HE'S TAKEN... BENJAMIN BUTTON'S (V.O.) \"...What I think is, it's never too late...or, in my case, too early, to be whoever you want to be...There's no time limit, start anytime you want...change or stay the same...there aren't any rules...We can make the best or worst of it...I hope you make the best...I hope you see things that startle you. Feel things you never felt before. I hope you meet people who have a different point of view. I hope you challenge yourself. I hope you stumble, and pick yourself up. I hope you live the life you wanted to...and if you haven't, I hope you start all over again.\"

document_metadata.summary: Daisy and Benjamin share a silent, emotional moment, acknowledging mutual heartbreak; he reveals he's staying at the Pontchartrain Hotel, unsure of his future, as they part without embracing.
document_metadata.source_title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,

chunks.content: A record's playing piano music. Classes are done. Parents taking their children. We see Daisy, in her long skirt... helping pick up with her hands and her nimble toes, errant clothing, the jackets, the sweaters... . CONTINUED: It takes us a moment to recognize her... in the some twelve years since we've last seen her, 56 now, her hair's cut short... and it's gone mostly gray... and, although her age is on her face, she still has a dancer's posture, her head held high... carrying herself with grace... and one thing that will never change, are her unforgettable blue eyes... We hear the door opening... Daisy, busy gathering, saying her goodnights... glances toward the door across the studio... And she sees a young Man has come in, a young man in his twenties... standing silently, a stranger, standing by the door... Daisy, as she closes up the studio, makes her way toward him, saying goodnight to people... she bends to pick up a ballet slipper... DAISY Somebody left their slipper... Daisy looks over, the young Man hasn't moved... the studio has all but emptied... she walks toward him... he's wearing worn trousers, a coat that's seen better days... DAISY (CONT'D) Are you here to pick someone up? He shakes \"no.\" Coming closer.... DAISY (CONT'D) I'm sorry, we're closed now. She moves to open the door to show him out... when she gets a good look at him. She stops, realizing who it is... DAISY (CONT'D) Benjamin? ...and she's taken aback by his youth, we all are... sixteen years younger... in his 20s now... it's at once staggering and heartbreaking... what age can do... And she realizes, at that very moment, he was right all along... DAISY (CONT'D) You're so young. They look at each other... When she's able to find the words... DAISY (CONT'D) Why did you come back? . CONTINUED: BENJAMIN I wanted to see you both.

metadata.doc_title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,
metadata.title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,
metadata.summary: Daisy and Benjamin share a silent, emotional moment, acknowledging mutual heartbreak; he reveals he's staying at the Pontchartrain Hotel, unsure of his future, as they part without embracing.
metadata.source_title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,

chunks.content: She stares at him... just the piano music. And despite the gulf of time... there's a terrible aching they have for each other... and before they can say anything... the door swings open and Caroline, 12, comes hurrying in... CAROLINE You ready, Mom? Benjamin stares at her appearance... And Daisy, can't help herself, and seeing Caroline, Daisy, overcome by it all, starts to cry. CAROLINE (CONT'D) Is something wrong, Mother? DAISY No... He was telling me a very sad story about a mutual friend we hadn't seen in a long time... This is my friend, Benjamin... you knew him when you were... just a baby... CAROLINE Hi... BENJAMIN Hello... He reaches, taking her hand... needing to touch her... A MAN'S (V.O.) Hello... And a Man 50s, wearing a suit and a tie, comes in... THE MAN I'm sorry... I thought you were done... DAISY This is a friend of my family's... Benjamin Button... this is my husband... Robert... They shake hands... There's an awkward quiet... ROBERT It was nice to have met you... We'll be in the car, darling... . CONTINUED: DAISY I'm just closing up... And Robert and Caroline go outside to wait for her... BENJAMIN She's so lovely... she looks like you... Does she dance? DAISY Not very well. BENJAMIN I suppose that would be from my side of things. `DAISY She's a dear sweet girl... she seems a little lost... But who isn't a little lost at 12? There's a lot of her that reminds me of you.

document_metadata.summary: Daisy and Benjamin share a silent, emotional moment, acknowledging mutual heartbreak; he reveals he's staying at the Pontchartrain Hotel, unsure of his future, as they part without embracing.
document_metadata.source_title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,

chunks.content: And she shuts off a set of the lights. DAISY (CONT'D) My husband. He's a doctor... was a widower... He's an incredibly bright, adventurous man... Benjamin smiles. DAISY (CONT'D) He's been a terrific father... and a great partner and friend... And she shuts off the record player and another set of lights... and for a moment they stand in the dark studio... and they look at their reflections in the mirror... seeing who they are now... DAISY (CONT'D) You're so much younger. BENJAMIN Just what you can see. She looks at him, and after all these years... she now understands completely... she looks outside at her daughter standing by the car with her \"father,\" waiting... . CONTINUED: DAISY You ware right. She needed a father. I couldn't have raised both of you. I'm not that strong.

metadata.doc_title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,
metadata.title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,
metadata.summary: Daisy and Benjamin share a silent, emotional moment, acknowledging mutual heartbreak; he reveals he's staying at the Pontchartrain Hotel, unsure of his future, as they part without embracing.
metadata.source_title: 266、INT. THE DANCE STUDIO, NEW ORLEANS - ANOTHER NIGHT,

chunks.content: He's quiet. They both are. She looks at him. DAISY (CONT'D) I never thought how it must have broken your heart, too. His silence is enough. DAISY (CONT'D) Where are you staying? What are you going to do? BENJAMIN I'm at the Pontchartrain Hotel on the avenue. I have no idea what I'm going to do. And it seems like they want to hold each other. But they can't. It's still. And aware of the car's headlights waiting at the curb... she turns, holding the door open for him... DAISY I have to go.He nods. He walks by her, going out.

Benjamin stands on the corner, hands in his pockets, the car driving by him... and Daisy can't help but look at him... and then the car's gone... and as he crosses the street and walks off into the night...

document_metadata.doc_title: 268、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.title: 268、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.summary: Caroline learns the young man was her father as a nurse warns of a hurricane's changing path; evacuation plans are underway while Daisy urges Caroline to continue reading Benjamin's story.
document_metadata.source_title: 268、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: CAROLINE That young man was my father? And a Nurse comes in. THE NURSE The hurricane changed directions again. They are predicting it will make landfall sometime soon. . CONTINUED: CAROLINE Is there anything we need to do? THE NURSE Arrangements are being made to move people if we have to. I'll let you know as soon as we know anything. She leaves hurriedly. DAISY Please tell me what he says? Caroline looks at the book. And Benjamin's voice comes in... BENJAMIN BUTTON'S (V.O.) "That night..."

document_metadata.doc_title: 269、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,
document_metadata.title: 269、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin and Daisy share an intimate moment, reaffirming their deep connection through touch and emotion as he reassures her of his enduring love.
document_metadata.source_title: 269、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,

chunks.content: Benjamin, sitting on the end of the bed, not sure why he came there at all... There's a sound at the door...as if somebody was there... BENJAMIN Hello? Its quiet...a hesitancy...He starts to get up and there's a knock on the door...He opens it...and Daisy's there. He's startled to see her... DAISY May I come in? BENJAMIN Please... She comes inside...an awkward quiet... BENJAMIN (CONT'D) I don't know what I'm doing here...What I expected...? It echoes how she's feeling being there...They stand not knowing what to say...And Daisy says, sadly... DAISY Nothing lasts. He puts a finger to her lips. He shakes "no." And what he's come to know, that some things do last... . CONTINUED: BENJAMIN I never once stopped loving you... He affectionately pushes a hair off of her forehead... DAISY I'm an old woman now, Benjamin. And he helps her off with her coat... She's still.

metadata.doc_title: 269、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,
metadata.title: 269、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,
metadata.summary: Benjamin and Daisy share an intimate moment, reaffirming their deep connection through touch and emotion as he reassures her of his enduring love.
metadata.source_title: 269、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,

chunks.content: DAISY (CONT'D) Benjamin... He kisses her... and she's quiet... and he undresses her... undressing himself... and they stand momentarily naked... the young man and the older woman. DAISY (CONT'D) Are you sure? BENJAMIN Some things you don't ever forget... the feel... the taste... And he kisses her again... BENJAMIN (CONT'D) ... the smell... He puts his mouth by her cheek... breathing her in... BENJAMIN (CONT'D) ... the touch...

document_metadata.title: 270、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin watches Daisy leave in a taxi, both sharing a silent, final goodbye as she waves and disappears from view, leaving him motionless at the window.
document_metadata.source_title: 270、INT. BENJAMIN'S HOTEL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - NIGHT,

chunks.content: We see Benjamin standing at the window watching as Daisy gets into a taxi... the taxi starting to drive off... and Daisy turning... to look back... waving to him. Benjamin waving to her... what they both somehow know, is a last goodbye... BENJAMIN BUTTON'S (V.0.) I watched her go... ..and as the taxi drives away... . CONTINUED: BENJAMIN BUTTON'S (V.0.) (CONT'D) Until she went out of sight... ...the taxi going down the street and out of sight... for the last time... Despite losing sight of her he still hasn't moved... standing by the window...

document_metadata.title: 271、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.summary: Daisy and Caroline sit in silence after reading the last written words; Daisy recalls a call that came a year after Caroline's father died, as wind rattles the window.
document_metadata.source_title: 271、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: Daisy, breath raspy, sitting silently in her bed looking out the window... We realize Caroline's stopped reading... DAISY Please read... CAROLINE That's the last thing he wrote... Daisy's quiet... they both are... alone with their thoughts... CAROLINE (CONT'D) What happened to him after that last time with you, Mother? The wind has picked up considerably, rattling the window even harder.. DAISY A year or so after your father passed... There was a call...

document_metadata.title: 274、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE - DAY,
document_metadata.summary: Daisy arrives at a dilapidated house, sees an old man on the porch, and enters through the back porch into the kitchen.
document_metadata.source_title: 274、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE - DAY,

chunks.content: Daisy gets out. The taxi drives off. Daisy stops for a moment before she opens the gate. The house has fallen into disrepair. A solitary old man sits on the porch rocking and rocking. She goes up the walk and out of habit goes around the back porch... to the kitchen... going inside...

document_metadata.doc_title: 275、INT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE DAY,
document_metadata.title: 275、INT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE DAY,
document_metadata.summary: Daisy offers Benjamin a place to stay as family, then hears unskilled piano playing and follows it into the parlor.
document_metadata.source_title: 275、INT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE DAY,

chunks.content: She comes into the kitchen. She moves down the hallway into the living room... The interior has also fallen on hard times. Some old people are still in residence -- predominantly African Americans now... Queenie's daughter, now in her fifties herself, stands in the living room... Along with a plain Man in a plain suit... DAISY I'm Daisy... The Man turns... THE MAN Thank you for coming... I'm David Hernandez with the Orleans Parish department of Child Welfare Services. Queenie's daughter turns on a lamp... it doesn't work... she crosses the room to turn on another... THE MAN (CONT'D) He was found living in a condemned building off of east Lamont... the police found this with him... this address... and your name... And he gives her the journal... . CONTINUED: THE MAN (CONT'D) He was in very poor health... he was taken to the hospital... He doesn't seem to know who or where he is... He's very confused... The doctors who looked at him think he may be autistic.

metadata.doc_title: 275、INT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE DAY,
metadata.title: 275、INT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE DAY,
metadata.summary: Daisy offers Benjamin a place to stay as family, then hears unskilled piano playing and follows it into the parlor.
metadata.source_title: 275、INT. NOLAN HOUSE - LATE DAY,

chunks.content: QUEENIE'S DAUGHTER I told Mr. Hernandez about Benjamin bein' one of us. I told him if he needs a place to stay... it's alright... he can stay here... he is blood after all... And just then we hear a PIANO playing... as if it were being played by a child... with no skill... banging as much as anything...And Daisy follows the sound of the piano into the parlor...

document_metadata.doc_title: 276、INT. PARLOR, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
document_metadata.title: 276、INT. PARLOR, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin, age 12, doesn't recognize Daisy but senses familiarity in her eyes; she sits with him as he plays piano, creating a moment of connection despite his memory issues.
document_metadata.source_title: 276、INT. PARLOR, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,

chunks.content: And she sees his back... just a boy of 12 now... hunched over... trying to play the piano... trying to play the tune the woman had taught to him... DAISY Benjamin. He turns at the sound of her voice. There is no indication he recognizes her at all. BENJAMIN AT TWELVE Do you know this song? And he tries to play what he thinks is the song, but is nothing more than a child playing random notes. DAISY You play really beautifully. She comes and touches his back... He shrinks from her touch. THE MAN He doesn't seem to like to be touched. And while he tries to play... CONTINUED: THE MAN (CONT'D) The doctors said if they didn't know any better, he goes in and out of states of recognition, as if he had the beginnings of dementia... Daisy's looking at the boy, who was once the man she loved... who she still loves... She looks into his eyes... DAISY Do you remember me? I'm Daisy.

metadata.doc_title: 276、INT. PARLOR, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
metadata.title: 276、INT. PARLOR, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
metadata.summary: Benjamin, age 12, doesn't recognize Daisy but senses familiarity in her eyes; she sits with him as he plays piano, creating a moment of connection despite his memory issues.
metadata.source_title: 276、INT. PARLOR, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,

chunks.content: He looks at her. No sense of recognition. BENJAMIN AT TWELVE Daisy is a very pretty name. I'm Benjamin. DAISY It's good to meet you Benjamin. Do you mind if I sit with you? I would love to hear you play. He doesn't say anything. She sits down beside him on the piano bench. He stops to look at her. BENJAMIN AT TWELVE There's something about you... There's something about your eyes I remember from a long time ago... He looks at her eyes. She looks at him...And as she sits with him on the piano bench... as he tries to play... Daisy and Benjamin, \"together again...\"

document_metadata.doc_title: 278、INT. THE KITCHEN, NOLAN HOUSE - MORNING,
document_metadata.title: 278、INT. THE KITCHEN, NOLAN HOUSE - MORNING,
document_metadata.summary: Eight-year-old Benjamin, often disoriented and forgetful, becomes upset when caregivers correct him, but finds comfort in Daisy's understanding as she gently redirects him.
document_metadata.source_title: 278、INT. THE KITCHEN, NOLAN HOUSE - MORNING,

chunks.content: And we see Benjamin, just eight now... coming into the kitchen... Queenie's daughter cleaning up after breakfast. BENJAMIN AT EIGHT I want some breakfast. . CONTINUED: QUEENIE'S DAUGHTER You just ate breakfast. BENJAMIN AT EIGHT No I didn't... AN OLD WOMAN You just finished eating, Mr. Button. BENJAMIN AT EIGHT You think I don't know what you are doing? And like an eight year old, or an old man old with onset Alzheimer's -- which makes him nearly a helpless child, he starts to rage... throwing things... BENJAMIN AT EIGHT (CONT'D) You are all fucking liars!

metadata.doc_title: 278、INT. THE KITCHEN, NOLAN HOUSE - MORNING,
metadata.title: 278、INT. THE KITCHEN, NOLAN HOUSE - MORNING,
metadata.summary: Eight-year-old Benjamin, often disoriented and forgetful, becomes upset when caregivers correct him, but finds comfort in Daisy's understanding as she gently redirects him.
metadata.source_title: 278、INT. THE KITCHEN, NOLAN HOUSE - MORNING,

chunks.content: DAISY'S (V.0.) And every day I would stop by... and make sure he was comfortable... And just then Daisy comes into the kitchen. She sees him raging. QUEENIE'S DAUGHTER He doesn't believe he's already had his breakfast. DAISY Let's see if we can find something else for you to do. BENJAMIN AT EIGHT (upset, meaning lapses) I can't help it. I can't help this. DAISY I know you can't. And as she puts her arm around him, taking him out of the room, understanding...DAISY'S (V.0.) Many times he would simply forget who and where he was at all...

document_metadata.title: 279、INT. BENJAMIN'S ROOM, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Daisy sits with Benjamin, who feels frustrated by forgotten memories of a past life, while she comforts him in his room.
document_metadata.source_title: 279、INT. BENJAMIN'S ROOM, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY

chunks.content: We see Daisy sitting on a bed with Benjamin in his room on the second floor of the old house... And he's oddly lucid...more articulate than his age would indicate... BENJAMIN AT EIGHT I get the feeling there's a lot of things I can't remember... DAISY What do you mean? BENJAMIN AT EIGHT It's like there's this whole life I had and I can't remember what it was... He's frustrated by it... DAISY It's alright... It's alright to forget things... And as she sits on his bed with him... in the upstairs room... DAISY'S (V.0.) It wasn't easy...

document_metadata.doc_title: 280、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
document_metadata.title: 280、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin, age six, considers flying from a roof; Daisy stops him with a story of a man who could fly, and he safely comes down, running into her arms.
document_metadata.source_title: 280、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,

chunks.content: And we see Benjamin, no more than six now, standing on the ROOF... Daisy standing on the ground down below him... DAISY (nervous) I wish you'd come down... BENJAMIN AT SIX (a little boy) I can see everything. And he points out... BENJAMIN AT SIX (CONT'D) I can see the big river... all the boats... I can see the graveyard where mama's buried and all those other people... I can see the city... where you have your dancing place... . CONTINUED: And tears fill Daisy's eyes... DAISY You're right, you can see everything sweetheart... And he can... he can see all the way across to the Mississippi River... the old graveyard... the city... his whole life... DAISY (CONT'D) I think you better come down...

metadata.title: 280、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
metadata.summary: Benjamin, age six, considers flying from a roof; Daisy stops him with a story of a man who could fly, and he safely comes down, running into her arms.
metadata.source_title: 280、EXT. NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,

chunks.content: BENJAMIN AT SIX What if I could fly? And it looks like he might just try... DAISY (stopping him) I knew a man who could fly. Come down and I'll tell you all about him. He's quiet, thinking about that. And acquiescing, he turns up the roof out of sight... some short moments...and he comes running out the front door... his hands in his pockets like the brave little man he is... Daisy bends down... and as he runs into her arms... Daisy holding him...

document_metadata.doc_title: 291、INT. BENJAMIN AND DAISY'S ROOM, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
document_metadata.title: 291、INT. BENJAMIN AND DAISY'S ROOM, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin closes his eyes and passes away peacefully in Daisy's lap, his stillness marking the end of his journey as she holds him.
document_metadata.source_title: 291、INT. BENJAMIN AND DAISY'S ROOM, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,

chunks.content: Shadows dapple the room. Daisy sitting in an old chair in the middle of the room... with daylight streaming in on her... holding Benjamin on her lap... a tiny thing now... nearly newborn... he can almost fit in her two old hands... DAISY'S (V.0.) He looked at me... And we see him looking up at her... DAISY'S (V.0.) (CONT'D) He looked into my eyes... And we see him looking into her eyes... . CONTINUED: DAISY'S (V.0.) (CONT'D) And he moved his fingers... and with his little thumb he held my thumb... ...and that's just what he does... looking into Daisy's eyes...holding her thumb with his tiny hand... DAISY'S (V.0.) (CONT'D) And as he had said... no matter what age he was... he was the same person behind his eyes... and, at that moment I knew... he knew who I was... The baby staring into her blue eyes...

metadata.doc_title: 291、INT. BENJAMIN AND DAISY'S ROOM, NOLAN HOUSE - DAY,

chunks.content: And then he closed his eyes like he was sleeping... And we see his eyes flutter and softly close... forever. And as he lays in his beloved Daisy's lap... completely still...

document_metadata.doc_title: 293、INT. A TRAIN SOMEWHERE IN INDIA - LATE AT NIGHT
document_metadata.title: 293、INT. A TRAIN SOMEWHERE IN INDIA - LATE AT NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Benjamin reflects in writing that age is irrelevant; what matters is making the most of life's journey and the meaningful connections formed along the way, however fleeting.
document_metadata.source_title: 293、INT. A TRAIN SOMEWHERE IN INDIA - LATE AT NIGHT

chunks.content: An overcrowded train car... people sitting and standing and lying on the seats and on the floor, in every available space, nook and cranny, asleep. I'm the only one who isn't sleeping. Now we see Benjamin sitting on the floor among all of the people, the only one awake, writing on the back of the train schedule. He observes the stillness of the travelers around him, each lost in their own world of dreams, while he remains fully conscious and reflective, an outsider in a sea of slumber.

metadata.doc_title: 293、INT. A TRAIN SOMEWHERE IN INDIA - LATE AT NIGHT
metadata.title: 293、INT. A TRAIN SOMEWHERE IN INDIA - LATE AT NIGHT
metadata.summary: Benjamin reflects in writing that age is irrelevant; what matters is making the most of life's journey and the meaningful connections formed along the way, however fleeting.
metadata.source_title: 293、INT. A TRAIN SOMEWHERE IN INDIA - LATE AT NIGHT

chunks.content: Benjamin continues writing, voiceover beginning: "I figured out one thing. If you're growing older or getting younger it really doesn't make any difference. Whichever way you're going you have to make the most of what this is." His words carry a quiet wisdom, shaped by a life moving contrary to nature, yet his insight applies universally—to every journey, every fleeting moment shared with others."Along the way you bump into people who make a dent on your life... Some people... get struck by lightning..."

document_metadata.title: 303、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT
document_metadata.summary: Daisy watches a hummingbird battle the storm to tap at her window, symbolizing infinity; she says goodnight to Benjamin and closes her eyes, embracing peace as darkness falls.
document_metadata.source_title: 303、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: CAROLINE He started to write something else... "I'm going..." But he stopped... She gently puts the card back. CAROLINE (CONT'D) I wish I had known him. DAISY Now you do. They're still. And the wind reminds her... . CONTINUED: CAROLINE I'd better go and see what they're planning to do... Daisy nods. Caroline goes out of the room... It's quiet. Daisy's alone now... looking out the window... at the howling, hurricane... a hundred mile an hour fury...

metadata.doc_title: 303、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

metadata.source_title: 303、INT. HOSPITAL ROOM, NEW ORLEANS - MORNING, PRESENT

chunks.content: And fighting against the wind, trying to reach the window is a hummingbird... it almost makes it and is pushed back by the gale... but undaunted, its wings doing a figure eight... the symbol for infinity... it fights its way through the wind to the window... tapping at the window... and the hummingbird flies away... she watches it go... and after some moments she says... DAISY Goodnight, Benjamin...And she closes her eyes for the very last time... and it's dark... where it's peaceful, even safe...
